title: Guest Chat reads owner-only context settings and reports permission errors
reproduction: On exact release 0.2.176, send a guest Chat turn. ops.system_error records chrome-extension users.user_surface_state SELECT 42501 permission denied, including during otherwise successful native guest turns.

The shared buildChatContext path calls ensureContextRulesReady without regard to auth. Its loadContextRules then SELECTs users.user_surface_state with an anon Supabase client. Read-only live grants show authenticated SELECT, no anon SELECT; authenticated RLS includes owner reads.
expected: Guest sends and Values opens use local session rules without an owner-table read; a signed-in person's rules load only for that identity and never bleed across account changes.
actual: Published Store 0.2.176 guest sends and Values opens attempt the owner-only users.user_surface_state read (HTTP 401 in the captured native chip-open request; backend logs separately record SQLSTATE 42501). Source previously retained rules across identity transitions and could let older reads or queued writes settle after a new identity took over. The fix now keeps guest rules local and invalidates prior identity work; member and Store verification remain pending.
severity: S2: visible context-settings failure and possible cross-identity rule state in a shared UI session
priority: P1: repair shared identity-aware context-rule boundary before trusting guest context controls

Live database read-only role grants and pg_policies inspection: authenticated SELECT exists with owner policy; anon SELECT grant absent.
